about: Dark Thrones is a 2D endless runner game. You play as 'Dark', an assassin on his last run to redeem himself and protect those he loves against legions of undead on top of an endless wall.

Jump over and slide under various obstacles. Have no mercy against every last unyielding enemy standing in your way to boost your score while collecting coins to upgrade power-ups strewn all across the wall.
The game supports two play methods which the user can choose from to control Dark:
Using the PS4 DualShock controller the player can use flicking gestures with the controller to make Dark jump and duck below obstacles. The X Button is used to wield their sword.
Using the PS4 DualShock controller the player can use the L/R sticks or D-Pad to make Dark jump up or duck down between obstacles.
The player collects coins which allows them to purchase upgrades from the in-game shop. These upgrades aid progression against the trophies.
summary: Dark Thrones is a 2D endless runner game. You play as 'Dark', an assassin on his last run to redeem himself and protect those he loves against legions of undead on top of an endless wall.
